sections.title: Termination of Resuscitation Algorithm
sections.focus: Every decision point and criterion in the termination-of-resuscitation algorithm, what happens on each branch, required documentation. Note the known conflict with 9.06 (agonal rhythm) — teach the algorithm as printed and say so in the explanation.
